aspect: The home state does it too
description: Iran has moved to seize assets of more than 100 citizens abroad and freeze their bank accounts. Exclusion is not the monopoly of the sanctioning side.
energy_note: Locked out of both countries' banking at once.

description: A flat in Tehran left to a child in Toronto cannot be sold, the proceeds cannot be transferred, and declaring the asset abroad may create tax liability on money that can never be received.
energy_note: Taxed on money you will never see.

aspect: Sending money home is a criminal-adjacent act
description: Supporting parents requires informal transfer networks. The sender is exposed to prosecution in the host country and the recipient to attention at home, for the act of giving a pension to a mother.
energy_note: Breaking a law to send your mother her rent.

aspect: Operation Economic Outcast raised the stakes again
description: Announced 24 August 2026, expanding sanctions risk for anyone doing business with Iran, with Treasury warning that facilitating entities will be cut off from the US financial system. Every bank in the world reads that as a reason to close more accounts.
energy_note: Each announcement closes another thousand accounts.
